title: Enforcement Decree of the Integrated Defense Act

metadata.completion_statement: This law has been fully translated from the supplied Korean source into English, including all supplied main text, chapter headings, Articles 1 through 37 and inserted articles, and all 23 addenda. Heading-only Articles 23-2 and 27-2 are retained as supplied. All consequential amendment instructions, dates, and omission notices are included. Standalone annex material is excluded as instructed. No existing English reference units were provided or used. The translation is MACHINE_TRANSLATION / UNREVIEWED.
